invariants.rationale: The method throws an exception if operationType equals LOG_COMPACT, so operationType must have been safely dereferenced and thus is not null.
The method instantiates TransactionManager and calls multiple table methods, implying table cannot be null.
instantTime is passed into table.getInstantGenerator().getCompactionInflightInstant(instantTime), so it must not be null.
pendingCompactionTimeline is dereferenced using containsInstant(), so it cannot be null.
The method immediately throws if operationType equals LOG_COMPACT, so upon normal exit this must be false.
